name: python-module-anchoring-is-defensive
body: `parse_args` composes each `--module` value as `args.root.join(value)`, so `run`'s canonical-root anchoring is defensive rather than the CWD fix the bug write-up described — for a relative scan root the value arrives already root-joined and the two orderings coincide, the only divergence being a symlinked scan root combined with a `..`-bearing value; upgrade by moving the join out of `parse_args` when the resolution rule must be provable from `run` alone.
